cases.prompt: Diagnose why tests/payments/payment-timeout.spec.ts alternates between a timeout and a pass. Twelve CI runs: 4101 to 4106 used 2 workers and all passed (1.8 to 2.2 s); 4107 to 4112 used 8 workers, and 4107, 4109, 4110, and 4112 timed out at 5 s while the others passed in 4.6 to 4.9 s. Seeds differ per run with no pattern. Failure log: "waiting for mock payment server on :4010". payment-timeout.spec.ts:3 reads `beforeAll(() => startMockServer(4010))` and line 9 reads `it('times out after 3s', ..., 5000)`. Every spec file that needs payments starts its own mock on port 4010.
